name: Last Day of Summer
overview: Rostov-on-Don. 13-year-old Stepan recently lost his parents and shut himself in. Now he has to take care of his sick grandmother on his own and resist the attacks of local bullies. To combat bullying, Stepan teams up with his classmates. New friends for the guy are a dreamy boy named Pooh, a pugnacious Vitya Kruger and a Shaman, the brother of a famous Rostov bandit.
